version: v1.7 muted palette and shoreline cleanup
palette: v1.7 muted palette rendered directly from decoded heightfield hues: muted deep blue sea, narrow light-blue coast band, sage lowlands, graded greens, restrained ochre highlands. Open sea is restricted to blue components connected to the map frame; the War Sails navmesh mask is not used to recolor terrain.
limitations: The pale-blue coastal band is a cartographic visual aid, not bathymetric data. Terrain is re-rendered from archived decoded-heightfield visualization, not raw calibrated altitude values. War Sails water map uses an archived navmesh plot calibrated from visible axis ticks; exact pixel-to-scene validation still requires original navmesh.bin/rendering script. War Sails port XY remains the candidate coordinate interpretation documented in RES-012.
